title: Jez Humble on DevOps Culture and Practices | GOTO Conference 2014

dimensions.historical_context_at_recording: RailsConf 2014 Chicago (Rails 4.1), GOTO Chicago 2014, Continuous Delivery boom with Jez Humble, Brakeman security adoption.
dimensions.subsequent_history_and_trajectory: Continuous Delivery became standard DevOps methodology globally; Jez Humble co-authored 'Lean Enterprise' (2015) and joined UC Berkeley.
